messages:
tara: Observed a tricky SR/focus interaction in Metrics > Top Models table. When the header becomes sticky on scroll, VoiceOver starts re-announcing the header and the focused row label twice. Repro: open Metrics > scroll so header sticks > Tab into table row action.
nate: thx. Is the sticky header a cloned DOM node or using position:sticky? Clones often cause duplicate announcements because both original and clone are exposed.
tara: it's a clone — we add a fixed clone for the sticky state so the header stays visible while the virtual list re-renders. Console shows: 
```
sticky-clone: added
original-header: aria-hidden=true // expected
focus: set to #row-12-action
aria-announce: "Model: Recommender v2"
aria-announce: "Header: Metrics"
aria-announce: "Model: Recommender v2"
```
so SR announces the row, then the sticky header, then the row again. Looks like focusing the row triggers a scroll which re-triggers cloning and a small blur/focus cycle.
kofi: cloning headers is a common cause. Two quick approaches: (A) clone but mark it aria-hidden and remove from accessibility tree, or (B) avoid cloning and use position:sticky with no DOM duplication. If we must clone (legacy reasons), ensure the clone has aria-hidden="true" and the original is kept present but offscreen for layout.
dena: also noticed that our focus-visible outline disappears when the clone appears because we use container transform for the sticky animation which creates a new stacking context and the outline gets clipped. Need to ensure focus ring is visible (increase z-index or avoid overflow:hidden).
a11y-bot: Automated checks: duplicate-announcements=1; sticky-clone-exposed=1; focus-visible-missing=1; virtualized-focus-heuristic=FAIL
tara: suggestion plan: (1) stop exposing the sticky clone to AT by setting aria-hidden=true on the clone and aria-hidden=false on the real header (but keep it visually hidden), (2) when virtualization causes re-render while focus is inside the list, insert a small inert focus sentinel (visually-hidden div role=status aria-live="polite") that briefly holds a short announcement like "focus preserved on row X" and then is cleared — only for Safari/VoiceOver and toggled via feature flag, (3) fix focus ring clipping by ensuring the focused element has overflow: visible or the ring is drawn on a higher z-index pseudo-element.
nate: I worry about inserting live announcements for every reflow — could be noisy. If we only emit the sentinel when we detect focus would be lost (i.e., focus target unmounted), it might be OK. Also set a short timeout to clear the live region text to avoid screen reader repeat.
kofi: agree. Implementation detail: data-focus-key on each row (stable id), on unmount compute next focusable and set focus there; if focus target is not found after 100ms, mount sentinel with polite message. Also for the clone: ensure clone has role=presentation and aria-hidden=true.
dena: for the CSS, I'll adjust the sticky container so it doesn't clip outlines. Plan: remove overflow:hidden on .table-wrapper when sticky active and move sticky header to a higher stacking context (.sticky-root) so focus rings are visible. I'll add visual regression snapshots for high-contrast and dark mode.
a11y-bot: Note logged RT-7533. Checks requested: macOS VoiceOver, Windows NVDA, ChromeVox. priority=medium
tara: owners: nate -> header clone change + audit other cloned UI; kofi -> focus preservation util + tests; dena -> CSS ring/clipping fix + snapshots. I'll file the ticket with repro GIF and console logs.
nate: will also search codebase for other uses of clones (modals, toasts) so we don't have similar duplication elsewhere.
kofi: I'll add unit tests simulating virtual list unmount/mount and assert focus remains on intended element or that sentinel is used only when necessary.
dena: can someone run ChromeVox quickly? I only have VoiceOver on mac.
tara: I can run ChromeVox later today and post notes. Meanwhile adding QA checklist to ticket: 
- macOS VoiceOver: open Metrics > scroll to sticky header > Tab into row action and Arrow through actions; confirm single announcement and visible focus ring
- Windows NVDA: same flow
- ChromeVox: ensure no duplicate header/readouts when clone appears
- Keyboard-only: Tab into table from toolbar, open row action, close with Esc, focus returns to row
- High-contrast/dark mode: snapshots for focus ring visibility
a11y-bot: RT-7533 created. severity=medium; regression-tests-needed=1
tara: target: small PRs for clone aria-hidden + focus util by EOD Fri, CSS fix by Monday. Thanks team :thumbsup:
